title: Order Intake
problem_statement: Customers need a reliable way to submit orders and receive clear outcomes.
scope: Capture an order submission and report its recorded status.
assumptions: The customer has already selected the items to order.
constraints: A rejected order must not be recorded as accepted.

actors.name: Customer
actors.description: Submits an order and receives its outcome.

use_cases.title: Submit an order
use_cases.objective: Record an accepted order or explain why it was rejected.

flows.subject: Customer confirms the order
flows.result: The order is recorded as accepted

flows.subject: The order fails validation
flows.result: The order is not recorded until validation succeeds
